title: 集草バッグ付き手押し芝刈り機
titleEn: Push lawn mower with grass catcher
description: 公園や住宅の庭の管理シーンに使う手押し芝刈り機。四輪、丸み付きデッキ、空冷エンジン、操作ハンドルと布製集草バッグを備えます。刈刃は密閉デッキ内として省略し、刈込み・燃焼・袋の変形などの動作はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.688 × 1.081 × 1.337 m、21,020三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A push mower for park and residential garden maintenance scenes, with four wheels, rounded deck, air-cooled engine, operator handle and fabric grass catcher. A blade is not modeled inside the enclosed deck; no cutting, combustion or flexible-bag behavior is supplied. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.688 × 1.081 × 1.337 m; 21,020 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
